did.abstract: Two 13x19" color photographic prints of the aftermath of Hurricane Sandy in Breezy Point and Rockaway Beach, Queens by photographer Margarita Mavromichalis.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This small collection is housed in a single folder with no particular arrangement.

bioghist.head: Biographical note
bioghist.p: Margarita Mavromichalis comes from a family of Greek diplomats. She moved to New York in 2009, where she studied at the International Center of Photography. She specializes in street photography but has also studied portraiture and travel photography.

phystech.head: Physical Characteristics and Technical Requirements
phystech.p: If digital surrogates exist, they should be used in place of the originals whenever possible.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Identification of item, date (if known); Margarita Mavromichalis Hurricane Sandy photographs, 2013.013; Brooklyn Public Library, Center for Brooklyn History.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Material found in collection and processed by Dee Bowers in November 2026. At that time, only two of the four photographs from the original accession were found.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Two 13x19" color photographic prints of the aftermath of Hurricane Sandy in Breezy Point and Rockaway Beach, Queens by photographer Margarita Mavromichalis.
